text: User (verbatim): "photos are also POIs". Photos are POIs of the live map: listed in /poi/list and its revision, filtered, marked and deleted with the other POIs; every /poi/list consumer handles them.

User (verbatim): "map cleanup didn't clean POIs (was supposed to)". Deleting a saved map removes its POIs and photos whatever the active-map state (after save, after restart); deleting the map that owns the live set also empties the live POIs and photos, deleting another map leaves the live set alone; web UI Reset map and the kidnap discard clear the live POIs and photos; saved bundles are never deleted by reset or kidnap; a new session deletes nothing.

User (verbatim): "POIs cleanup didn't delete photos". A photo POI in the set of a single delete, clear, delete-marked or replace loses its record and its JPEG; photo kind is selectable in the clear filters of poi_store, the web UI dialog and MCP clear_pois.

User decision (verbatim): "Map is supposed to be saved with POI, which includes photos." A map save writes the POIs and the photos (records and JPEG files) into the bundle; a map load restores both into the live set, replacing the live photos; deleting a saved map deletes its bundled photos.
Delete results report the actual counts removed (POIs and photos), in poi_store, map_manager, the web UI and MCP; no silent success.
